It shows that the company must retain a $5,000,000 liquidity floor and that the approved maximum principal tendered must be exactly $6,500,000. This forecast is not yet in the approval workbook. The proposed $10,000,000 principal amount would exceed our liquidity constraints — and even the $8,000,000 cap Jonas flagged would still be too high. We need to reduce the cap to $6,500,000 to stay within our liquidity requirements.
